scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.dev:bg: pnpm --filter @novarium/web build >/dev/null && pnpm dev:stop && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local >/dev/null && mkdir -p /tmp/novarium-tickets && (nohup wrangler dev --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8787 > /tmp/novarium-tickets/wrangler.log 2>&1 &) && for i in $(seq 60); do curl -sf http://localhost:8787/api/health >/dev/null && echo 'ready: http://localhost:8787, log: /tmp/novarium-tickets/wrangler.log' && exit 0; sleep 1; done; tail -20 /tmp/novarium-tickets/wrangler.log; exit 1
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.deploy:cf: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
